author: NotPineapple203
body:
I submitted a map that got accepted for testing over the summer. However, it had no XML, so Dev just said they'll do it after Atlas comes out.

They didn't do it for a while (Which is okay, because school years were starting) and then about two weeks ago I asked if anything was happening with it. 

So just wanna know about how long do maps take to test and get approved.

https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/19988204e
*Contains map link too
